purpose: real TCP backend load, correctness under concurrency, bounded overload and recovery
latency: nearest-rank percentiles of successful operation wall time; drain included, warmup excluded
reporting: per-trial successful throughput, P50/P95/P99, errors/statuses, resource samples, actual database row delta, cleanup; preserve failures
limitations: closed-loop is not fixed offered QPS
bounded ramp does not prove an absolute maximum
fixed-model Agent test is not model quality or multi-agent throughput
